context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useLogin mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce. Tests knowledge of the hook's expected input shape ({ email, password }), async mutation invocation, and proper handling of loading and error states during authentication.

checklist.name: Uses useLogin hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useLogin from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce, not a custom fetch or direct API call.

checklist.name: Correct mutation arguments
checklist.description: The mutation function is called with { email, password } collected from the form inputs.

checklist.name: Loading state handling
checklist.description: The submit button is disabled during the async login mutation to prevent duplicate submissions.

checklist.name: Error display
checklist.description: When the mutation throws, the error message is captured and shown to the user.

checklist.name: onSuccess callback
checklist.description: The onSuccess prop callback is invoked after a successful login mutation resolves.
